outOfScope: Tuning product behavior during release acceptance.
Changing packaging/runtime behavior to make a frozen release candidate pass.
Executing release-reserve tasks before exact release freeze.
Treating CI success, merge state or a working-tree demo as release value evidence.
Claiming a SLSA level or certification; SLSA provenance fields are design guidance only.
constraints: Worker execution requires exact DONE BB-074 and BB-075 plus compatible delivered distribution/profile evidence; incompatibility yields PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.
Release freeze binds source/tree, dependency-resolution manifest, supported profile, HOW policy, build/install procedure and produced artifact digests before release-reserve model execution.
BB-076 is the first task allowed to execute BB-075 RELEASE_RESERVE; any prior model result invalidates the reserve.
All release-reserve and lifecycle evidence must run against the packaged/frozen release, not working-tree product code.
Missing/unknown primary cost or incomplete registered evidence yields INCONCLUSIVE, never implicit success.
invariants: Application owns work semantics and domain authority; Oracle owns source IO; runtime success is not acceptance or publication authority.
Every result binds exact source, attempt, configuration and evidence; unknown effects or missing evidence cannot be called success.
The outer Blackboard schedules ExHarness development only; product runtime coordination remains a separate system.
architectureDecisions: D1 — Worker start resolves exact DONE BB-074 and BB-075 plus the exact transitive dependency closure of BB-076 from the canonical work graph. It emits RELEASE_DEPENDENCY_MANIFEST_V1; missing, non-DONE or stale prerequisite evidence is PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.

D2 — RELEASE_DEPENDENCY_MANIFEST_V1 binds each ancestor work id to its current objective/plan and delivered implementation-result/judgment/delivery identities when applicable, and explicitly extracts the supported distribution contract (BB-073), lifecycle contract (BB-071/074), supported harness profile (BB-081), benchmark substrate/value evidence (BB-065/077/074), and HOW policy/decision (BB-059/075).

D3 — BB-076 performs release acceptance only. It consumes the delivered BB-073 distribution/build/install contract; if no reproducible artifact/dependency-resolution/install identity is delivered, BB-076 fails PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION rather than inventing packaging or modifying product source.

D4 — Freeze a release candidate before paid reserve execution: source commit/tree, dependency-resolution manifest digest, supported harness/product profile, current HOW policy, exact delivered build/install procedure, builder/runtime identity, produced artifact digests, benchmark protocol hashes and release-reserve manifest hash.

D5 — Emit SUPPORTED_RELEASE_PROVENANCE_V1 inspired by SLSA provenance v1.2 source/dependency/builder/invocation/subject fields. It is local provenance evidence only and makes no SLSA level/certification claim.

D6 — Clean-room reproduction starts from the exact supported environment declared by the delivered distribution contract, with no working-tree checkout, and installs only frozen release artifact(s) by digest. It verifies provenance, dependency/runtime compatibility, actionable missing-credential failure, reference delivery, independent QA and one change/recovery preflight before opening paid reserve runs.

D7 — BB-076 is first opener of the exact four-task BB-075 RELEASE_RESERVE. Any prior model result, cohort overlap, task digest drift or reserve-manifest drift invalidates the reserve and returns to research.

D8 — Release-value arms are D=BB-077 DIRECT_CODEACT control and R=ExHarness installed from the frozen release artifact. Both run through the delivered BB-065 substrate and @exharness/benchmark lifecycle with identical task/prompt/model/provider/tool/evaluator/resource ceilings; BB-076 adds release provenance and human/lifecycle observations only.

D9 — Run four reserve tasks x two repeats x two arms = 16 registered arm units with counterbalanced order and fresh substrate/runtime/provider state. Every execution/retry remains a separate shared AttemptLedger attempt with immutable evidence/accounting binding.

D10 — Release value gates remain predeclared: accepted R>=D with zero critical escaped defects; operatorActiveMs(R)<=0.80*D; known providerCostPerAccepted(R)<=1.10*D; duplicate effects/currentness bypass=0 and required recovery negatives pass.
D11 — Re-run all six BB-074 lifecycle scenarios against the packaged release, not working-tree code, and bind acceptance/effort/cost/recovery/fence/failure evidence to exact release provenance.
D12 — Generate SUPPORTED_RELEASE_MANIFEST_V1 from delivered evidence and compare it with user-facing support documentation. Unsupported claims or omitted known limitations are release failures.

D13 — A deterministic reducer returns RELEASE_ACCEPTED, RELEASE_NO_GO or INCONCLUSIVE. Complete evidence plus any required identity/value/lifecycle/documentation gate failure is RELEASE_NO_GO; missing/unknown/drifted primary evidence is INCONCLUSIVE.

D14 — Product/package source writes are forbidden in BB-076. Acceptance may write benchmark/release verification tooling and Living truth only; a discovered product/distribution defect is routed upstream instead of patched inside release acceptance.
implementationSlices: S1 — Prerequisite closure: implement benchmarks/release_acceptance/dependency.mjs to recompute BB-076 transitive dependencies from canonical work-graph.json, require the plan-bound ancestor set and DONE status, resolve every current objective/plan/delivery/judgment identity, and emit RELEASE_DEPENDENCY_MANIFEST_V1. Extract exact BB-073 distribution, BB-071/074 lifecycle, BB-081 harness-profile, BB-065/077/074 benchmark and BB-059/075 HOW-policy contracts; any gap stops PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION before build.

S2 — Release build/freeze adapter: implement scripts/release/build.mjs as a thin consumer of the exact delivered BB-073 distribution contract. Invoke only its declared artifact/export procedure, capture dependency-resolution and builder/runtime identities, hash all produced subjects, and emit immutable RELEASE_FREEZE_V1 plus SUPPORTED_RELEASE_PROVENANCE_V1. If the delivered distribution contract cannot supply these identities, stop PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION rather than invent packaging.

S3 — Independent clean-room gate: implement clean-room.mjs to create the exact supported fresh environment declared by BB-073, make no product checkout available, install only frozen artifact subjects by digest, verify provenance/runtime/dependency identity, exercise missing-credential diagnostics, then run reference delivery + independent QA + one change/recovery preflight. Failure blocks release-reserve dispatch.

S4 — Reserve boundary and value run: verify the exact BB-075 RELEASE_RESERVE has no prior model result, materialize D/R fixed-factor manifests, and execute all 16 registered units through @exharness/benchmark + the delivered BB-065 substrate with fresh state. report.mjs adds release-specific quality/human-effort/cost/safety/currentness views without reimplementing generic attempt/evidence/accounting truth.

S5 — Packaged lifecycle reproduction: run all six BB-074 lifecycle scenarios against the exact frozen artifact/profile and record independent acceptance, operatorActiveMs, elapsedMs, providerCost when live, recovery/fence result and failure fingerprint with the release provenance hash on every scenario.

S6 — Support contract audit: implement support-manifest.mjs to derive SUPPORTED_RELEASE_MANIFEST_V1 from RELEASE_DEPENDENCY_MANIFEST_V1 plus observed clean-room/value/lifecycle evidence and compare it to user-facing support docs; unsupported claims or missing known limitations are explicit failures.

S7 — Release decision/publication: implement decision.mjs to reduce complete bound evidence to RELEASE_ACCEPTED|RELEASE_NO_GO|INCONCLUSIVE. Only RELEASE_ACCEPTED updates Living truth to a supported release; RELEASE_NO_GO records exact failed gates/remediation scope; INCONCLUSIVE preserves no release claim. No path mutates product source.

negativeVerificationCases: Canonical transitive dependency set differs from the plan-bound closure, any ancestor is non-DONE, or a required delivery/judgment identity is missing.
Delivered BB-073 distribution contract lacks reproducible artifact, install, dependency-resolution or supported-environment identity but BB-076 invents packaging instead of PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.
Release artifact digest differs from provenance or installed source/profile identity.
Clean-room run reads working-tree/uncommitted product files or uses a hidden manual patch.
Source, dependency-resolution manifest, HOW policy, supported profile or delivered build procedure changes after release freeze.
RELEASE_RESERVE model result predates BB-076 or overlaps any previous benchmark task.
Unknown primary provider cost is represented as zero.
Fewer than 16 registered release-reserve units are represented as complete.
Direct and release arms use different evaluator, model/provider, tool envelope or resource budget.
Any required lifecycle scenario is omitted or run only against working-tree code.
Duplicate effect or stale-worker/currentness bypass is tolerated because quality passes.
Support documentation claims unsupported behavior or hides a known limitation.
CI/merge success is substituted for release value evidence.
Failed value/lifecycle/identity/documentation gate is downgraded to a limitation instead of RELEASE_NO_GO.
BB-076 deep-imports benchmark internals, invokes Harbor directly, or creates a local generic AttemptLedger/evidence/accounting/audit layer.
BB-076 mutates packages/benchmark/** or benchmarks/substrate/** instead of consuming the exact delivered benchmark contracts.
